qa.answer: Four options. Truck the container via the Johor causeway (about USD 1.7K, no slip, recommended), buy 180 units locally from Jurong Aero Consumables (USD 1.4K net premium, USD 12.6K new PO), wait for the feeder (USD 8K of LDs, Orchid Regional moves 2 days), or start WO-2614 on the 20 units in stock and re-sequence the wash (no cost, but it strips WO-2640 and depends on the feeder landing by 21 Oct).

Re-sequencing on stock is the cheapest at no cost, but 20 units against a need of 180 leaves the check exposed to any further berth delay. Of the options that hold the redelivery without planning risk, the Jurong buy has the lowest net premium at USD 1,440, USD 8 a unit above Klang, while the causeway truck costs about USD 1.7K and avoids a second PO.

In 2025 berth waits at Port Klang reached 10 days for feeder sailings (PRE-10). We trucked the consumables via the Johor causeway for USD 6.2K and they landed in 2 days by road. The lesson was that road via the causeway beats feeder sailings whenever berth waits pass 4 days, and today's wait is 7 to 9 days.

WO-2614 inducts into Hangar 5 bay 1 on 16 Oct and needs 180 units of cleaning concentrate from PO line 4500018687-00010. The feeder delay moves SHP-880488 from 12 Oct to 21 Oct, a 5 day slip against 3 days of float, so the Orchid Regional Airways redelivery moves 2 days from 11 Nov to 13 Nov.
